# Rainfall CMS TEAM reports

<p class="wp-dek">Quarto + R briefings for mandated TEAM states and Rainfall territories. California is the full whitepaper; other titles are drafts rebuilt from the website guides against the live roster.</p>
:::

```{r}
#| label: hub-setup
#| include: false
source("R/00_setup.R")
source("R/01_load_data.R")
roster <- flatten_roster()
territories <- load_territories()
```

**National roster in this extract:** `r nrow(roster)` hospitals across `r dplyr::n_distinct(roster$state)` states / jurisdictions.

## State whitepapers

```{r}
#| label: tbl-states
state_hub <- tibble::tribble(
  ~abbr, ~href, ~status,
  "CA", "states/california/index.qmd", "Whitepaper",
  "CO", "states/colorado/index.qmd", "Draft",
  "FL", "states/florida/index.qmd", "Draft",
  "LA", "states/louisiana/index.qmd", "Draft",
  "MA", "states/massachusetts/index.qmd", "Draft",
  "MN", "states/minnesota/index.qmd", "Draft",
  "NJ", "states/new-jersey/index.qmd", "Draft",
  "NY", "states/new-york/index.qmd", "Draft",
  "PA", "states/pennsylvania/index.qmd", "Draft",
  "TN", "states/tennessee/index.qmd", "Draft"
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Report = sprintf("[%s](%s)", abbr, href),
    Roster = vapply(abbr, function(a) nrow(load_team_hospitals(a)), integer(1))
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(Report, Roster, Status = status)
knitr::kable(state_hub)
```

## Territory region briefings

California is split by CBSA between Territory 1 (NorCal) and Territory 2 (SoCal).

```{r}
#| label: tbl-regions
region_hub <- tibble::tribble(
  ~id, ~label, ~href,
  "t1", "NorCal, PNW & Rockies", "regions/norcal-pnw-rockies/index.qmd",
  "t2", "SoCal, Southwest & Gulf South", "regions/socal-southwest-gulf/index.qmd",
  "t3", "Northeast", "regions/northeast/index.qmd",
  "t4", "South & Midwest", "regions/south-midwest/index.qmd"
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Report = sprintf("[%s](%s)", label, href),
    Roster = vapply(id, function(i) nrow(load_territory_hospitals(i)), integer(1)),
    Status = "Draft"
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(Report, Roster, Status)
knitr::kable(region_hub)
```

## Render

```bash
Rscript -e 'renv::restore(prompt = FALSE)'
quarto render                 # HTML site → _site/
Rscript R/render_all.R pdf    # Typst PDFs beside each index.qmd
```

Data: `data/territoryHospitals.json` (March 2026 CMS TEAM participant extract). Shared ggplot theme and DM Sans live in `R/` and `fonts/`.
